mentions.name: PixoSpritz
mentions.description: A toy game engine for WebGL, developed slowly over several years. It is roughly 90% usable but remains rough, messy, and somewhat fragile after LLM-assisted feature additions, with the long-term goal of building a proper game with it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a toy game engine for webGL called PixoSpritz (https://pixospritz.com) and its been something I have been lazily working on for a number of years, but its a slow crawl.
mentions.author: kderbyma
